intro: Mauritania is an Islamic republic with an elected president.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for five years and appoints the prime minister. The National Assembly passes laws.

chapters.title: Security
text: Mauritania has largely avoided the violence affecting its Sahel neighbours.

keyTerms.meaning: A republic based on Islamic principles.
